platform: WXYC 89.3 Chapel Hill Music Director Email Submission Route

platform: WUSB 90.1 Stony Brook Music Director Email and Physical Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WUSB authorizes music delivery to md.wusbradio@gmail.com or to its Music Director postal address but does not publish accepted digital formats, attachment limits, download-link rules, metadata fields or physical-media preferences. A human must choose the route, confirm the package requirements and prepare any digital or physical delivery.

platform: WHRB 95.3 Harvard Department-Targeted Physical Promo Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WHRB prefers physical CD or LP promo copies and requires each package to be addressed to the appropriate department or a named department member; unassigned submissions may be treated as inappropriate. A human must review department descriptions, select the correct destination, prepare the physical release and verify the current recipient before shipping.

platform: WFMU Jersey City Physical Music Review Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WFMU accepts vinyl, CD, CD-R and cassette review copies through separate postal and UPS/FedEx addresses addressed to Music Director Jessica Romoff. Physical production, carrier selection and address handling require human action. The linked Music Department contact form requires JavaScript and is suitable for questions, not an automated replacement for the published physical submission route.
